D: A psychiatrist starts seeing a terrifying smiling presence after a disturbing session with a patient.
P: Serve dessert when Rose finally heads back to her childhood home.
S: Cheddar mashed potato rounds baked crisp with a pressed on smile
Mashed potato mixed with cheddar and a little flour, rolled out, cut into rounds with two eyes and a wide smile pressed in, baked at 220C for 15 minutes until crisp.
her sister's family party in the backyard

Smoky slow-roasted pork shoulder pulled and tossed in barbecue sauce, piled on soft slider buns with crunchy apple slaw and pickles. Rub a 1.5kg boneless pork shoulder with 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and 2 tsp salt. Put in a covered dish with 200ml apple juice and roast at 150C for 4 hours until it pulls apart. Shred and toss with 200ml barbecue sauce. Shred a quarter cabbage and 1 green apple into matchsticks and toss with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 tbsp cider vinegar. Fill 12 split slider buns with pork, slaw and pickles.
Buttermilk soaked fried chicken bites with a honey mustard dip
Crunchy bite-size buttermilk fried chicken pieces with a honey mustard dip. Soak 600g diced chicken thigh in 250ml buttermilk for 1 hour.
M: Roast salmon with lemon dill butter and crushed potatoes

Salmon fillet roasted skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes, with lemon and dill butter, crushed potatoes and green beans. Roast 4 salmon fillets skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes. Melt 60g butter with lemon juice and dill and spoon over. Crush 800g boiled potatoes with butter. Steam 300g green beans.
Late-shift miso ramen with soft eggs
the long nights she can't sleep

Rich miso and chicken broth over springy ramen noodles with seared pork belly, jammy soy eggs, corn, spring onion and a drizzle of chilli oil. Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and soak in 100ml soy, 100ml water and 1 tbsp sugar for 2 hours. Slice 500g pork belly and pan fry until crisp. Heat 1.6 litres chicken stock with 2 grated garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger, then whisk in 4 tbsp white miso and 1 tbsp soy off the boil. Cook 4 serves ramen noodles. Divide noodles and broth into bowls and top with pork, halved eggs, corn, spring onion and chilli oil.
W: Sugar cookies iced pale yellow with a wide red smile
Vanilla sugar cookies cut into rounds, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced pale yellow with a wide red smile piped on. A little unsettling.
K: Chamomile tea with honey, lemon and whisky, served hot

Chamomile steeped strong, stirred with honey, lemon and a nip of whisky, served hot in mugs with a cinnamon stick and a lemon wheel studded with cloves. Steep 4 chamomile tea bags in 800ml just-boiled water for 5 minutes, then remove. Stir in 4 tbsp honey and the juice of a lemon. Add 30ml whisky to each of 4 mugs, pour over the tea and finish with a cinnamon stick and a lemon wheel studded with 3 cloves. Leave out the whisky for a plain version.

Pat the tofu dry, cut into 4 thick slabs, season with the salt and dust with the cornflour.
Fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes a side until crisp.
Melt the remaining butter with the lemon juice and dill and spoon over.
Steam the beans.
